definitions.explanation: The perspective from which one views or judges things; one's role or situation.
The circumstances or position one finds oneself in, especially regarding responsibility or social role.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{立場|たちば}に{立|た}って{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think from the other person's standpoint.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{立場|たちば}も{分|わ}かってください。
examples.english: Please understand my position as well.

examples.japanese: {立場上|たちばじょう}、{言|い}えないことがある。
examples.english: Due to my position, there are things I cannot say.
examples.notes: 立場上 = due to one's position

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立場|たちば}に{立|た}つ (to stand in someone's position)
- {立場|たちば}を{考|かんが}える (to consider one's position)
- {立場|たちば}が{悪|わる}い (to be in an awkward position)
- {立場上|たちばじょう} (due to one's position)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {相手|あいて}の{立場|たちば}に{立|た}つ (to put oneself in someone else's shoes)
- {立場|たちば}が{逆転|ぎゃくてん}する (for positions to be reversed)
- {立場|たちば}を{利用|りよう}する (to take advantage of one's position)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立場|たちば}: Position, standpoint (personal perspective)
- {観点|かんてん}: Viewpoint (more analytical)
- {地位|ちい}: Status, rank (social hierarchy)
